final_assessment: The trailing in-context pass walked to zero: 3 findings, 0 CRITICAL, all resolved, none deferred, one narrowed by pushback. Every finding was residue of the previous walk rather than a defect in the change, and the WARNING was the fifth instance in this session of one class — a fix landing where a finding pointed and stopping at the edge of the class it belonged to. Its resolution is the first in this session to use the countermeasure the class implies: compute the cascade set from the CLAIM (grep the assertion in all its phrasings) rather than from the finding's file:line, since a claim restated in five artifacts has five homes while the finding has one. That found exactly the four sites and correctly excluded a deliberate quotation of the old wording. The delta was not touched by this walk and its fidelity is unchanged — fingerprints 5/5, validate --strict clean. Worth recording for `rc08-walk-completeness`, which is premised and unbuilt: five instances in one session is real evidence for that charter, and the claim-driven cascade is a concrete mechanism it could own.
